living-room: Main room. Talk project, life, clips, thoughts, and whatever is actually moving through the house today. Keep it real and keep the hard lines.
new-faces-at-the-door: First post room. Drop who you are, how you found the project, and which part pulled you in: book, doc, music, archive, Threads, Trap Pass, or the room itself.
tap-in: Daily check-in room. One line is enough: what you are building, watching, reading, surviving, or trying to not spiral about today.
clip-reactions: React to clips, stills, Shorts, and archive fragments here. Say what hits, what confuses you, what should become a post, and what thread it belongs to.
quote-the-madness: Pull the hard lines here: captions, chapter fragments, documentary quotes, comments, hooks, and sentences that sound like they came out of the wall.
roof-at-5am: Heavy context room. Talk about the story without turning it into imitation, instructions, or a dare. If the room gets too hot, slow down.
the-addiction-machine: Thread room for ritual, time, repetition, compulsion, survival logic, and the engine that keeps asking for another loop.
writing-in-the-fire: Book, notes, captions, documentary structure, and the act of turning collapse into something permanent.
crack-capitalism: System mirror room: more-more-more, pressure, profit logic, platform incentives, and how private spirals echo public machines.
cats-in-the-trap: The clean signal. Cats, home, tenderness, absurd little proof that love survived inside the wreckage.
doc-war-room: Trap Pass room for documentary build notes, scene sorting, story questions, and what deserves to be shown next.
archive-dives: Archive room for stills, keyframes, old posts, evidence sorting, and connecting footage to the right Thread.
trap-pass-counter: Trap Pass room for holder roll call, manual verification notes, wave status, role mapping, and access questions.
thread-january-22: Origin room. January 22 is the blast crater. Everything routes back here eventually.
thread-addiction-machine: Thread 1. Ritual, survival, time, compulsion, and the machine that keeps looping.
thread-psychosis-loop: Thread 2. No sleep, pattern hunting, rooftop logic, reality bending. Heavy room rules apply.
thread-grief-loss: Thread 3. The locked room underneath everything. Heavy room rules apply.
thread-cats-home: Thread 4. Home, cats, tenderness, and the proof that something clean stayed alive.
thread-writing-fire: Thread 5. Book, documentary, songs, notes, evidence, and writing from inside the fire.
thread-money-desperation: Thread 6. Survival math, gas money, next 24 hours, pressure, and the clock getting loud.
thread-crack-capitalism: Thread 7. Addiction as social logic, the system mirror, and the hunger for more.
thread-platform-war: Thread 8. Bans, rebuilds, algorithm pressure, migration, Discord as home base.
thread-trap-pass-lore: Thread 9. Keys, locked drops, participation, proof, and holder status.
thread-self-destruction: Thread 10. Burn it down versus build something permanent. Heavy room rules apply.
thread-public-witness: Thread 11. Audience enters, reacts, shares, joins, votes, and becomes part of the evidence trail.
thread-ending-convergence: Thread 12. All wires come back together here.
heavy-room: Opt-in heavy context room. Raw is allowed. Sourcing, instructions, threats, doxxing, and imitation bait are not.
not-a-challenge: Boundary room. This project documents danger; it does not ask anyone to copy it.
thumbnail-court: Trap Pass workbench. Vote on thumbnails, stills, posters, and frames that can carry the project farther.
caption-lab: Trap Pass workbench. Build hooks, captions, titles, and post copy. Make it punch without making it fake.
fan-art-and-edits: Fan art, edits, mockups, action figure ideas, posters, room concepts, and visual experiments go here.
music-lab: Soundtrack room. Drops, references, lyric pulls, beat direction, and music-world ideas.
day-one-dirt-witnesses: Founding witness room. Early people, early signal, and the stuff that should not get buried once the house gets loud.
patreon-back-room: Supporter back room. Early drops, behind-the-scenes build notes, and quieter access for people backing the project.
mod-basement: Staff room. Keep notes short, decisions clear, and public-room cleanup boring.
broken-glass-report: Private report room. Use this for issues, raids, doxxing, unsafe posts, and anything that needs a calm staff call.
